title: Add read-only order finance reconciliation view
description: Add a read-only reconciliation view that correlates existing Sales/Purchase Orders with existing expense, receipt/payment or settlement records where authoritative references already exist. This task must not create schema, rewrite historical data, or infer links that are not supported by persisted references.
acceptance_criteria: Order detail exposes linked finance records only through authoritative existing references.
The view reports linked amount, document/reference number, status and date and clearly distinguishes unlinked/unknown amounts.
No heuristic or text-only match is treated as authoritative linkage.
Queries are bounded and avoid N+1 behavior for normal order-detail use.
Unit/integration tests cover linked, partially linked and unlinked histories; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Open an order with linked finance records and inspect reconciliation.
Open an order without authoritative finance linkage and verify unknown/unlinked presentation.

human_gate.reason: Read-only correlation over existing records; no production schema, data rewrite, deployment or release.
